opening.argument: The video presents a Goldman Sachs small-business program built around education, capital access, and business support services. Its stated purpose is to provide “greater access to business education, financial capital, and business support services,” while participants describe practical management lessons they could immediately apply to their companies. The reported growth, including one business moving from 13 employees to over 100 and another reporting income above three and a half million dollars, is presented as participant experience rather than a promised return. The “GROW REVENUE” wording fits that business-development focus. Nothing supplied describes a required payment, credential request, deceptive condition, or solicitation of investment returns.

citations.quote: program helps small businesses create jobs and economic opportunity by providing greater access to business education, financial capital, and business support services.
It made so much sense in that every day that I left there, there was something on my list. That I could immediately apply to my business.
The time I took the program we had 13 employees. Now after the program we have over 100.
Our income was $400,000. We are over three and a half million.
